The '''Fujari''' were a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that committed various acts of piracy in the [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Bordal Contagion]]. They raided a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] attempting to bring the [[Bordal Contagion antidote|antidote]] to the [[Bordal]]i, which caused the cure for the contagion to be ruined. Various organizations in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] allied with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in order to defeat the Fujari and other pirates.

Soon after this, the Trade Federation sent [[Starship/Legends|ships]] to the Fujari's [[Fujari asteroid base|asteroid base]], where the Fujari were ultimately defeated within a timespan of a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] of the destruction of the [[Hajara gang]], another pirate organization.<ref name="EGtW:AC" />
